facts.title: leek toasts with blue cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds leeks (about 3 big leeks), lengthwise and white and pale green parts sliced 1/4-inch thick (about 3 generous cups of slices)
1 tablespoon olive oil, plus extra for brushing toasts
6 medium-sized or 12 baguette-sized 1/2-inch slices of bread of your choice
2 ounces blue cheese, crumbled (a soft or crumbly goat cheese would also work)
facts.author: Deb Perelman
